_about: Partner roster TEMPLATE for the MATCH step. Roles are proposals, not commitments: every role is 'proposed – to be confirmed with partner'. Capacity, confirmation and contact fields are intentionally empty and are filled only by the partner. Supports, does not replace, county and State plans.

source.document: HAIC_AI Challenge_Submission_DHS_Disaster_2026.pdf (2026 HAIC AI Challenge Submission, Hawaii DHS: 'Enhancing ESF-6 Planning Through AI-Supported Insights')
source.note: Partner types are those named in the DHS challenge statement. The statement also names philanthropy, other state and county agencies, and the business community (p.3); they are not in this template yet.
